arguments.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.user_id) AS users_with_online_transaction, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users) AS total_users FROM transactions t JOIN cards c ON c.id = t.card_id WHERE t.transaction_type = 'Online Transaction'
arguments.explanation: Counts the distinct users who made at least one online transaction, alongside the total number of users in the database.
assumptions: Users are linked to transactions through their cards (cards.user_id).
No date filter, so the whole period 2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31 is included.
Transactions with a null or negative amount are included, since no amount filter was requested.
